create_leaderboard_class: create a Leaderboard dataclass with end_date, scoring_metric, competition_id, and token fields
fetch_public_leaderboard: fetch the public leaderboard as a ranked DataFrame from a Hugging Face competition dataset
fetch_private_leaderboard: fetch the private leaderboard with private scores as a ranked DataFrame from a competition
process_public_submissions: process public leaderboard submissions by filtering successful ones before the end date and selecting best per user
process_private_submissions: process private leaderboard submissions by selecting based on private scores and handling selected submission limits
